summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting that its adjourned Annual General Meeting of Shareholders was held on September 29, 2026, at the company's Petach Tikva, Israel offices. Shareholders approved each proposal described in the August 18, 2026 proxy statement, except Proposal No. 3, which the company withdrew per the September 17, 2026 proxy supplement. The meeting adopted amended and restated articles of association, filed as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-result filing, not a special situation; watch for any subsequent disclosure behind the withdrawn proposal.
